name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A light that travels around the border of its parent card. Decorative, follows the parent's radius.

props.name: size
props.description: Length of the beam in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one lap around the border.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before the beam starts.

props.name: colorFrom
props.description: Color at the head of the beam. Any CSS color.

props.name: colorTo
props.description: Color along the tail of the beam. Any CSS color.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Run the lap in the opposite direction.

props.name: initialOffset
props.description: Where on the border the beam starts, 0 to 100 (percent of a lap).

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Thickness of the lit border in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the beam element.
